title: What We Still Have to Solve
spine: Follow the source’s city into cheaper electricity whose binding constraint moves to connection, continue into desalination whose constraint moves to access and environmental management, then make those observed service gaps the reason to read the book’s framework for correctable institutions.

source.scope: Full chapter map and prior full 20-line film; complete source-1,3,6,7,8,9,10,11,15,40,42,43,44,46. Source-15 and source-44 read completely in contiguous bounded ranges. Not the whole 250k-character book or an external reference audit.
source.genre: Systems synthesis: empirical claims, interpretation and proposed institutional designs explicitly distinguished.
source.images: Inspected all four non-cover source diagrams (pages18,27,71,86). Adapt the energy-to-outcomes relationship and corrective feedback through physical scenes; omit literal boxed raster layouts and AI-authority flow to avoid overloading a short reading invitation.

scenes.title: Progress meets the next constraint
lines: What We Still Have to Solve asks why technological progress leaves important problems unresolved.
Its opening hospital depends on electricity, water, deliveries, trained staff, and public trust.
A heatwave can strain several of those systems at once.
The book follows these connections instead of treating each crisis as an isolated subject.
Its distinctive question is what becomes the next constraint when an intervention succeeds.
scenes.emotionalPlan: Everyday confidence opens into concern as ordinary services depend on one another, then curiosity about a more useful diagnosis.
scenes.artPlan: A colorful inhabited city cross-section, not a hospital icon with four cards. A clinician works beside a cool medicine cabinet while a delivery worker arrives at a loading entrance. Water actually travels through a pipe to a sink; an exterior cooling unit is visibly powered from the street. As heat rises outside, cooling works harder while a second visible household also needs power. The view widens enough to show the shared feeder and water route; no patient collapse, invented medical outcome, operational instructions or numeric load data. This is the source’s explicitly imagined ordinary morning. Keep the central service intelligible and reserve the entire subtitle zone.

scenes.title: Cheaper is only the beginning
lines: Consider the book's example of electricity generation becoming dramatically cheaper.
That improvement still needs grid connections, transformers, skilled crews, and workable permits.
Otherwise, falling production costs can coexist with slow connections and high household prices.
The bottleneck has moved, so buying more generation no longer addresses the whole problem.
Readers learn to distinguish missing technology from infrastructure, incentives, and authority that cannot coordinate.
The chapters follow these changing constraints through climate, health, poverty, security, and AI.
scenes.emotionalPlan: Optimism about a real technical gain meets a visible incomplete connection, yielding a specific diagnostic insight rather than pessimism.
scenes.artPlan: Shift to a panoramic cutaway across the city’s edge: a completed solar field has its production-cost indicator fall without fabricated numbers, while its output cable ends at an unfinished connection trench. Household service remains unresolved on the other side. A transformer arrives on a transport trailer, trained crew and interconnection approval must meet at the same unfinished site; the plan shows these as pending dependencies, not an electrician tutorial. Adding one more panel changes the field but leaves the physical gap unchanged. Then the camera follows the gap rather than celebrating the panel count. This enacts a moved binding constraint; avoid five separate icons or a symbolic gate. Source Figure 2.1 supplies the relationship but its rounded boxes are translated into a spatial situation.

scenes.title: Power opens a water question
lines: Cheap power also changes which water supplies become practical.
Desalination can expand supply, but electricity is only one requirement.
Membranes, pipelines, brine disposal, and access rules still shape the outcome.
Producing fresh water does not decide which households can receive it.
The book's method keeps those consequences inside the original promise of a solution.
scenes.emotionalPlan: Discovery that an energy gain opens another possibility, then attention shifts from production to distribution and environmental responsibility.
scenes.artPlan: A large coastal desalination cutaway with seawater intake, a clearly drawn membrane, freshwater outlet and separate concentrated-brine stream. The separation moves water through two physically distinct routes without claiming that ordinary mesh removes dissolved salt; label Membrane beside the membrane. Freshwater travels toward a storage tank and a connected public tap, while another nearby household still has a capped distribution branch. The brine branch ends at a visibly unresolved management area, not a depiction of harmless ocean dumping or ecological catastrophe. Add an adult carrying an empty water container at the unconnected tap, not a generic presenter. This continues the energy example into a new constraint using the book’s own desalination discussion. No invented prices, efficacy percentages, technical operating procedure or guaranteed access reform.

scenes.title: A system that can change course
lines: The constructive direction is a civilization able to detect mistakes and change course.
That means preserving evidence, protecting challenge, and testing assumptions before scaling commitments.
AI could widen that feedback, rather than decide society's values.
Begin with Why Solving One Bottleneck Reveals Another, then follow The Corrigible Civilization.
Read it to judge a solution by the complete service people actually receive.
scenes.emotionalPlan: A frustrated beneficiary becomes visible to the institution; the film ends with agency through inquiry rather than a solved-world guarantee.
scenes.artPlan: Widen from the water system to a review of actual service: the operator initially looks at a full production tank while the unconnected resident points to the still-dry tap. The resident’s observation travels into the shared review record, and the planning view is updated to include the missing distribution branch. The proposed extension remains a testable plan rather than instantly appearing as a guaranteed reform. One AI comparison highlights the difference between the original production target and the reported service outcome while humans retain the decision. Source Figure 6.1’s detect/contain/continue/repair/learn sequence informs the feedback logic without copying its five boxes or claiming society is literally one machine. Finish with a proportionate open book showing the two actual chapter headings; no decorative magnifier or repeated slogan.

evidence.heading: A NOTE ON EVIDENCE, INTERPRETATION, AND SPECULATION
evidence.quote: It asks a different question: what becomes visible when the largest problems are treated as interacting systems rather than as isolated headlines?

evidence.heading: 1.1 A Morning Inside a Coupled Civilization
evidence.quote: Before breakfast, a hospital has already depended on the electricity grid, pharmaceutical supply chains, clean water, digital identity systems, refrigerated logistics, trained staff, public finance, telecommunications and public trust.

evidence.heading: 1.1 A Morning Inside a Coupled Civilization
evidence.quote: A heatwave raises electricity demand just as river levels constrain a power plant and wildfire smoke worsens respiratory illness.

evidence.heading: 1.1 A Morning Inside a Coupled Civilization
evidence.quote: The important question is therefore always two questions: what direct problem does an intervention solve, and what new dependencies does it create?

evidence.heading: 1.4 Why Solving One Bottleneck Reveals Another
evidence.quote: Solar modules can become cheap while grid interconnections become slow.

evidence.heading: 1.4 Why Solving One Bottleneck Reveals Another
evidence.quote: Systems that continue optimizing a constraint after it has ceased to be binding can spend enormous resources while outcomes barely change.

evidence.heading: 1.5 The System Is the Unit of Analysis
evidence.quote: Can the grid connect the new supply? Are transformers and skilled crews available? Can permits be issued in a reasonable time?

evidence.heading: 1.5 The System Is the Unit of Analysis
evidence.quote: If those constraints are ignored, falling generation costs can coexist with slow connections and high retail prices. The bottleneck has moved from production to infrastructure or institutions.

evidence.heading: 1.4 Why Solving One Bottleneck Reveals Another
evidence.quote: The map developed in this book therefore has three layers. The first contains material and biological constraints: climate, ecosystems, energy, water, food, disease. The second contains social coordination problems: inequality, war, demographic adaptation, governance and the distribution of opportunity. The third contains cognitive infrastructure: how civilization knows, predicts, deliberates and learns.

evidence.heading: 2.2 Energy Expands the Feasible Set, Not the Moral One
evidence.quote: Reverse-osmosis plants do not create water from nothing; they use membranes, pressure, pretreatment and electricity to separate fresh water from salts.

evidence.heading: 2.2 Energy Expands the Feasible Set, Not the Moral One
evidence.quote: As electricity becomes cheaper and cleaner, desalination becomes feasible in more places, but the solution still has local constraints: intake ecology, brine disposal, pipelines and the political question of who receives the water.

evidence.heading: 2.2 Energy Expands the Feasible Set, Not the Moral One
evidence.quote: Energy removes one barrier and reveals the next.

evidence.heading: 2.2 Energy Expands the Feasible Set, Not the Moral One
evidence.quote: Energy abundance creates options; institutions still decide which options are built, who owns them, which externalities count and how benefits are distributed.

evidence.heading: 6.6 The Corrigible Civilization
evidence.quote: A better question is not whether the future will be good. It is whether our systems are becoming better at correcting themselves.

evidence.heading: 6.6 The Corrigible Civilization
evidence.quote: The first is observability: the system has to measure outcomes that matter rather than only outputs that are easy to count.

evidence.heading: 6.6 The Corrigible Civilization
evidence.quote: The second is contestability: people with contrary evidence need a legitimate route to be heard.

evidence.heading: part of the control system.
evidence.quote: Sunset clauses, audit trails, independent review, appeal rights, staged deployment and reversible pilots are all methods for keeping commitments contestable.

evidence.heading: 6.6 The Corrigible Civilization
evidence.quote: Rather than imagining an oracle that decides the future, we can use AI to widen the feedback channel: compare policy outcomes with predictions, search large bodies of law for contradictions, translate public consultations, monitor infrastructure, reproduce analyses, surface minority evidence and simulate alternative assumptions.

evidence.heading: 6.6 The Corrigible Civilization
evidence.quote: A capability portfolio and a culture of correction are not substitutes for political choice.

evidence.heading: THE WORK THAT REMAINS
evidence.quote: When a solution creates a new bottleneck, move attention rather than defending yesterday's success metric.

technicalBoundaries: No fabricated prices, statistics, dataset findings, project outcomes or guaranteed welfare effect.
Desalination uses a membrane process; a simple sieve is not a scientifically adequate metaphor.
The new grid constraint can coexist with cheap production; it is not a universal causal claim about every retail tariff.
Corrigible civilization is a proposed metaphor, not a single machine or an AI authority over society.
The review illustration records and proposes a changed service plan, without inventing a guaranteed political resolution.
supersedesDefects: Prior film promised a moving bottleneck without showing the next constraint.
Final magnifier did not reveal what the reviewer should notice.
